hypothesis: M173 showed that rows 67, 70, and 77 are knife-edge binary flips, so boundary replay rows should be split into robust promotion rows and knife-edge stress rows before further PPO or objective redesign.
success_criteria: classify M162 boundary replay rows by normal and wrong-history margin slack under the admitted M168 checkpoint

identify knife-edge rows such as 67, 70, and 77
compare M170 and M171 failures on robust rows versus knife-edge rows
define whether future promotion should require robust-row retention, knife-edge stress reporting, or both
failure_criteria: run more PPO before classifying robust versus knife-edge rows
relax gates simply to pass M170 or M171
discard knife-edge rows without documenting their diagnostic role
use aggregate fixed objective loss as the main promotion signal
